name: Chita (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Chita city emblem in navy: a winged device with a pointed top above a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Chita, a city in Aichi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Chita city emblem — a winged device with a pointed top above a ring
